blocks.text: Cloverdale Neighbourhood Guides: Cloverdale, Clayton and Serpentine

parts.t: One guide for each Cloverdale MLS® area: Cloverdale BC, Clayton and Serpentine. Each covers schools, parks, planning and what to check before you buy, with a source next to every fact.
Written by Jared Gibbons, REALTOR®, Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, on October 13, 2026. I have worked in Fraser Valley real estate since 2015.

blocks.text: Looking at a home in Cloverdale?

parts.t: Send me the address and I’ll check its zoning, plan designation and anything that could affect value before you write an offer.
Tap a guide to open it.
The town centre, the new hospital, schools, parks and heritage
SkyTrain stations, the Clayton Corridor Plan, schools and parks
Acreages and farms, ALR and floodplain rules, wells and septic
Short guides to each Cloverdale area I work in. Each covers schools, parks, planning and what to check before you buy.
On the MLS®, the Cloverdale areas are Cloverdale BC, Clayton and Serpentine.
Where do the facts come from?
From official sources such as the City of Surrey, Surrey Schools and the Province. The source is noted next to each fact.
How do I check the school for an address?
. Catchments can be split, so check your own address.
How do I see current Cloverdale listings?
Use the listing links on this page, or call or text me at 604-928-1361.

items.t: South Surrey and White Rock neighbourhoods

parts.t: These pages are general information, not legal, planning, tax or financial advice. Confirm anything that matters with the City of Surrey, Surrey Schools and your own advisors before you buy or sell.
